description: Type the unpaired-realm rejection on SAC attachment create (HTTP 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT: 'The request was invalid: sac_realm must be attached to a partner realm'). A SAC realm must first be paired with the SSE partner's realm (Palo Alto Prisma Access / Symantec) outside of GCP; without that the attachment can never be created, so callers need a specific tag instead of an out-of-union BadRequest. Observed live 2026-09-29 in us-central1.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The SAC realm is not attached to a partner (SSE vendor) realm yet (HTTP 400: 'sac_realm must be attached to a partner realm'). Pair the realm with the partner first; not retryable.

message.includes: must be attached to a partner realm
